data.long_meaning: Bana: to adorn, Mali: lotus. Banamali is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. She is often depicted holding a lotus in her hand, representing creation and purity. The name Banamali is a tribute to her grace and abundance. The name Banamali carries the meaning “Lady with lotus in hand” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Banamali usually hope their child will grow to embody lady with lotus in hand and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Banamali was a famous Hindu poet and scholar, who lived during the 16th century in Bengal, India. He was a prominent figure in the Bengali literary world and is best known for his works on the Bhagavad Gita and the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata.

Banamali was also a disciple of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, a prominent figure in the Bhakti movement in medieval India. He is revered for his devotion to Lord Krishna and his compositions in Bengali and Sanskrit.
